performance_case.causal_mechanism: A fixed-root Local pipeline that derives identity only from the canonical task-SHA-bound sealed handoff manifest can survive lawful pre-outcome source restarts without accepting caller-selected packages.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This implementation may prove only offline Local pipeline identity and archive integrity. It cannot access forward outcomes or establish prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown improvement, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployment, or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Market drawdown improvement remains MISSING_PROOF until a later preregistered matched-capital experiment passes Validation and sealed OOS gates.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A false negative wastes the current fourteen-day slice and forces another untouched window; a false positive could weaken package identity and admit the wrong data, so legacy and R1 compatibility must pass without broadening task, root, path, hash, chain, or create-once authority.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: The implementation cannot improve fee-adjusted PnL directly, but preventing deterministic rejection of a valid completed slice reduces time to a credible accept-or-reject strategy decision without increasing candidate count or relaxing scientific gates.
